notes.title: Play Test 13a - The City is back!
notes.content:
[b]Happy Holidays![/b]

- the City is back.  It's still very rough and not optimized though.  The island is much smaller now, which is better for performance.  The mission is still the same for now.

- added Pedestrians in the city.  They will run if they hear gun shots or if you crash your car nearby.  You can do Wrestling Finishers on pedestrians for easy +health.  Think of pedestrians as walking health kits ːsteamhappyː

- KB's car can now get damaged.  It has 1000 hp.  It will get damaged from gunshots and crashing it too much.  Eventually I will add a car mechanic in the city to repair the car, but the mechanic will want something from you.

- explodable barrels work well now.  Bigger explosion radius.

- street lights and traffic lights can break if rammed too hard with KB's car

- Heavy Beans will never become dizzy now, so you can't use a finisher on them.

- I removed the slow motion on the Side Suplex to speed up the game flow.


[u]REMOVED[/u]:
- removed volumetric sky and replaced it with a simple sky.  It still looks the same, but performance is better.

- removed Interrogations.  It was causing too many bugs, so I will make the enemies just drop phones or thumb drives for info.  Eventually I will add laptops in buildings to find info too.


[u]NEXT UP[/u]:
- I will combine the City island with the procedural islands to make a campaign.  The City will be the hub where KB can buy weapons and upgrades.  The procedural islands will be where the Main Missions take place.  Side missions will be in the City.

notes.title: Playtest v004k - Game Controller support added & World Streaming
notes.content:
Lot of bug fixes + new features!

NEW FEATURES
- Game Controller support, only for game play currently.  Menus don't work with controller yet.  Make sure to 'Restore Defaults' to get the default bindings for game controllers.
- Aim Assist for game controllers.  Makes it easier to target enemies and strafe target.
- World Streaming.  Most objects are now streamed off hard drive to greatly reduce ram usage.
- KB's Car is much snappier now.  Maybe too snappy
- KB's Car can do a small jump now (space bar) if you get stuck
- Slow Mo Dives cancel if you run out of ammo.
- Crouching increases accuracy
- Shotgun spread is tighter when aiming down sights

BUG FIXES
- KB can get shot again
- Slow mo dives out of car work better now
- Aim Down Sights works after exiting car
- I think that's it.
